ApprovalStateOut.description:
Where the approval of a reply stands, for anyone who may read the conversation (staff
cannot decide, but they see whether their reply is waiting, approved or turned down).
ApprovalStateOut.title: ApprovalStateOut

ContentApprovalStateOut.description:
Where the approval of the item stands, for anyone who may read content (staff cannot
decide, but they see whether their submission is waiting, approved or turned down).
ContentApprovalStateOut.title: ContentApprovalStateOut

ContentCheckItemOut.description:
One submit rule that was broken (``errors``) or only worth a look (``warnings``)
(plan.md G17). ``field`` names what it is about (``caption``, ``media_asset_id``,
``schedule``, ``scheduled_at``, ``social_account_id``, ``overlay_text_suggestions.{i}``);
``null`` for the claim check, whose ``params.issues`` lists the claim issues.
ContentCheckItemOut.title: ContentCheckItemOut

ContentGenerate.description:
Ask for an AI draft (plan.md G7). ``client_request_id`` is required: it makes a retry
return the first draft instead of paying for a second generation.
ContentGenerate.title: ContentGenerate

ContentPatch.description:
A field that is absent is left alone; a field sent as ``null`` is cleared (caption,
media). ``title`` cannot be cleared.
ContentPatch.title: ContentPatch

DecisionIn.description: What the user saw and chose. The hash must be the one the client displayed.
DecisionIn.title: DecisionIn

FactPatch.description:
Only the fields that are sent change. ``valid_from``/``valid_until`` may be null to
clear the window.
FactPatch.title: FactPatch

GenerationOut.description:
Where the AI draft of an item stands: the status of its ``agent_runs`` row (G7). A run
that has succeeded counts as ``running`` until its text has been saved on the draft.
GenerationOut.title: GenerationOut

LocalScheduleIn.description: A wall-clock time in the workspace timezone (never an instant: the server converts).
LocalScheduleIn.title: LocalScheduleIn

OperationOut.description:
An allow-list for failure explanations: never the provider reference, the result payload
or the error detail (they may hold provider text and identifiers).
OperationOut.title: OperationOut

ReportLinkOut.description: Where something leads: an API path and/or a frontend route.
ReportLinkOut.title: ReportLinkOut

SocialAccountOut.description: An allow-list: no credential, token or key column is ever part of a response.
SocialAccountOut.title: SocialAccountOut

SubjectLinkOut.description: Structured so the API stays free of frontend routes.
SubjectLinkOut.title: SubjectLinkOut

ValidateIn.description: Optional body of the dry run: with a schedule the schedule and quota rules run too.
ValidateIn.title: ValidateIn

WorkspaceSettingsPatch.description: Partial update of the settings: only the given top-level keys change.
WorkspaceSettingsPatch.title: WorkspaceSettingsPatch

get.description: The latest jobs of the workspaces the user belongs to (and system jobs).

post.description: Run what is due now, in this process (when no worker is running).

schema.title: Response Scripts Api V1 Dev Scripts Get

post.description:
Run the health check of this workspace's degraded accounts now (demo and E2E), instead of
waiting for the periodic check. Recovery enqueues ``resume_account`` like the job does.

Reset a demo workspace (H15): a new id, the same slug/members/settings and yesterday's
history. ``workspace.manage``; only ``is_demo`` workspaces (else 403), a demo workspace
outside the seed data is 409.

get.description: Read-only: what the mock Instagram published, as evidence of exactly one post.
Public, non-secret configuration for the SPA.

schema.title: Response Get Delegation Api V1 Workspaces  Workspace Id  Accounts  Account Id  Agent Delegation Get

post.description:
Permission is checked per approval (``required_permission``, or the requester of a
confirmation), so any member reaches this route and unauthorised ones get 403.
The owner confirms the automation settings were looked at. Idempotent.

Ask the AI for a draft: the draft exists at once (202) and fills in when the job has
run. The same ``client_request_id`` again returns the first draft (200).
A dry run of the claim validation and every submit rule. Changes nothing.
A verifier gets the verified fact (201); staff get a pending candidate (202).
